_: Sentences a model provider has actually refused a run with, copied out of
this runtime's own run logs — never paraphrased, never written from the
provider's documentation. test/unit.mjs reads every row and asserts that
src/lib/refusal.js reads the kind and the reset time this file names.
Why a data file: the first version of the reader was written from the
shapes the documentation describes and matched none of the 37 refusals
the host recorded on 2026-10-18, because this box says 'You've hit your
session limit' and the reader wanted 'limit reached'. A new shape is now
a row here, added by whoever reads the log, and the assertion comes free.
'at' is the instant the reader is given, so a bare clock has a fixed
answer; 'resetAt' null means the provider named no moment and the
runtime is expected to fall back to its floor for that kind.
Nothing personal is in here by construction: a row is the provider's
sentence and the status field beside it, with no seat, path, repository
